title: Natural Language Toolkit (NLTK): Uncontrolled recursion (crash DoS) in Synset.tree()/acyclic_tree() via WordNet…
description: NLTK versions prior to 3.10.4 contain a vulnerability in the Synset.tree() and Synset.acyclic_tree() methods where recursive traversal lacks a maximum call-depth safeguard. This can lead to a crash via unhandled RecursionError when processing a long, genuinely acyclic relation chain in a custom WordNet-format lexical resource. The default bundled WordNet corpus is not affected due to its shallow relation depths. The vulnerability does not affect Synset.closure(), which uses an iterative traversal method. A fix is available in version 3.10.4.
